HEADLINE: The J3 harmonic-representation optimisation lane is CLOSED. No further attempt will be made on the consumed BabySlakh corpus to discover a single universal tonal representation or reliability gate that simultaneously maximises harmonic information, low-register accuracy and visual restraint.

C3_ROOT_SALIENCE.purpose: answer - when is tonal change sufficiently trustworthy and musically meaningful to justify visual motion?
C3_ROOT_SALIENCE.basis_of_selection: demonstrated visual selectivity and stillness, NOT maximum symbolic-information score

fine_resolution_pitch_information.role: a SEPARATE retained capability, not a replacement for C3
fine_resolution_pitch_information.purpose: improve tonal-state observability where the existing 16 kHz / n_fft 2048 STFT resolution is limiting, particularly in the low register

supporting_measurement.why_it_counts: two unrelated front ends independently reproduced the low-register gain

fine_resolution_pitch_information.status_limit: the existing HOST multirate implementations establish INFORMATION VALUE ONLY. They do NOT constitute an authorised product frontend. The J3N filterbank is non-causal (zero-phase filtering) and the J3O front end is an external GPL research dependency.

EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_ARCHITECTURE_ASSUMPT.rejected: that one universal chroma or pitch-class representation must serve all downstream musical purposes
EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_ARCHITECTURE_ASSUMPT.what_the_evidence_supports_instead: multiple musical views with distinct responsibilities
EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_ARCHITECTURE_ASSUMPT.future_scope_note: higher layers may eventually combine harmonic restraint, resolved tonal state, orchestration/source context, confidence and musical semantics according to the downstream decision being made. THAT FUTURE POLICY IS NOT SPECIFIED OR AUTHORISED BY THIS DECISION.

SYNTH_PAD_LIMITATION.status: UNRESOLVED and PARKED. This is a known limitation, NOT an optimisation backlog item.

what_has_been_tested_and_failed.instrument: deterministic same-STFT projection changes and peak methods

what_has_been_tested_and_failed.outcome: PITCH_FRONTEND_RESOLUTION_SIGNAL - a low-register win, no weak-family solution

what_this_residual_is_NOT: evidence that harmonic intelligence is impossible
evidence that no causal solution exists
SYNTH_PAD_LIMITATION.what_it_means: further work is unjustified unless it introduces genuinely NEW EVIDENCE rather than another transformation of the same evidence
SYNTH_PAD_LIMITATION.conditions_for_a_legitimate_reopening: must motivate at least one materially new information source - longer causal temporal structure, richer causal spectral-envelope dynamics, source/orchestration context, or another independently justified descriptor
explicitly_not_a_reopening: a larger learned head on the same inputs
assorted MIR techniques applied to the same consumed corpus

RESEARCH_DOCTRINE_RETAINED.the_operative_criterion: Does the system react to musical change when it should, and remain visually still when it should not?
RESEARCH_DOCTRINE_RETAINED.the_failure_rule: more MIR information accompanied by worse restraint is a FAILURE for this consumer
RESEARCH_DOCTRINE_RETAINED.standing_practice: recall-above-own-null (circular-shift chance floor) is reported automatically and is never a gate

ANALYST_FLAGS_RAISED_BEFORE_ADOPTION.status: raised by the analyst, NOT part of the PM's decision text. Recorded so they are on the record rather than lost in conversation. The PM may strike any of them.

F1_the_oracle_construct_question_is_clos.what_is_closed: J3J and J3K tested a repaired acoustic-activation target and returned TARGET_CORRECTION_IMMATERIAL and MIXTURE_TARGET_CORRECTION_IMMATERIAL. J3K Axis A found 89.02 percent exact event overlap and 3.18 percent unmatched. The target-TIMING lane is genuinely closed.
F1_the_oracle_construct_question_is_clos.what_is_NOT_closed: whether MIDI note-occupancy is the right NOTION of harmonic change for a sustained pad at all. A pad that swells, filters and morphs without any note event is labelled STABLE by the oracle while C3 reports movement - and a listener might side with C3. Every restraint measurement in this programme, including the synth false-movement figures that closed seven lanes, inherits that construct.
F1_the_oracle_construct_question_is_clos.why_it_does_not_change_the_decision: C3 is still the best-performing descriptor on the visual criterion, and the visual test uses the same oracle for every arm, so the COMPARISONS stand.
F1_the_oracle_construct_question_is_clos.why_it_belongs_on_the_record: it changes what a legitimate reopening looks like. If the residual is partly a construct artefact, the new evidence required is a better DEFINITION of pad harmonic change - which is a target question, not a representation question - and that is not on the reopening list as currently written.
F1_the_oracle_construct_question_is_clos.cost_to_settle: not settleable on this corpus. It needs listener judgement or a differently-constructed target on fresh material.

F2_the_parked_family_may_be_over_represe.observation: sustained synth pads, drones and electronic textures are exactly the material an ambient lighting product is likely to spend a lot of time playing
F2_the_parked_family_may_be_over_represe.implication: the residual is parked in the family that may carry disproportionate product weight, so 'known limitation' should carry an expected-exposure note rather than being filed as an edge case
F2_the_parked_family_may_be_over_represe.not_a_research_question: this is a product-weighting judgement for the PM, not something the corpus can answer

F3_C3s_absolute_level_has_never_been_ask.measurement: C3 recovers 0.2812 of 0.4073 oracle selectivity margin - 69 percent
F3_C3s_absolute_level_has_never_been_ask.the_unasked_question: is 69 percent of oracle selectivity ENOUGH to produce acceptable lighting? The programme has only ever compared candidates against each other and against the oracle. Nobody has established the product-acceptability floor.
F3_C3s_absolute_level_has_never_been_ask.why_it_matters_now: adopting C3 as the accepted descriptor makes this the live risk. It is a product question, answerable by looking at renders, not by another representation experiment.

F4_the_split_descriptor_architecture_has.observation: keeping fine-resolution pitch as a second view implies a second front end eventually reaching M85. J3N explicitly declared compute out of scope, correctly for that job.
F4_the_split_descriptor_architecture_has.implication: the decision is sound as a research conclusion and carries an unestimated engineering cost. At some point 'compute is not the question' stops being true, and it would be better to know the number before the architecture hardens.

F5_every_future_J_job_now_needs_fresh_da.observation: all 20 BabySlakh tracks are consumed. The decision closes a lane partly because nothing more can be learned from this corpus.
F5_every_future_J_job_now_needs_fresh_da.implication: fresh-corpus provisioning is now the binding constraint on ALL future work in this programme, not just on reopening the synth residual. It is not named anywhere in the decision and probably should be.

AMENDMENT_01.nature: dispositions on the quarantined analyst flags. The original decision text above is UNCHANGED; this block records what the PM did with each flag.

F1_target_meaning.reasoning: the target-TIMING question is closed (J3J, J3K). The target-MEANING question is not. Whether MIDI note occupancy is the correct definition of PERCEIVED harmonic change for sustained/evolving timbres has never been tested.
F1_target_meaning.effect_on_the_reopening_clause: the SYNTH_PAD_LIMITATION reopening conditions are EXTENDED to admit a fifth admissible source of new evidence: NEW TARGET-SEMANTIC EVIDENCE - fresh perceptual evidence that MIDI note occupancy is not the correct definition of perceived harmonic change for sustained or evolving timbres.
reopening_conditions_as_amended: NEW: target-semantic evidence about perceived harmonic change in sustained/evolving timbres

F2_parked_family_exposure.note: sustained pads, drones and electronic textures may be over-represented in actual product listening. This is a product-weighting judgement, not a research question.

F3_absolute_acceptability.disposition: ADOPT as a PRODUCT RISK, explicitly NOT a MIR research task
F3_absolute_acceptability.reasoning: C3 is established as the best candidate among those tested. Its absolute quality has never been established. 0.2812 against a 0.4073 oracle margin is about 69 percent of oracle selectivity.
F3_absolute_acceptability.required_action: a C3 absolute product-acceptability review on representative renders. Eyes, not another R-squared table.
F3_absolute_acceptability.explicitly_not: a scientific gate. It does not need a pristine research holdout.
F3_absolute_acceptability.sequence_position: after MIR-CORPUS-01, before stepping up into musical-state fusion

F4_compute_debt.disposition: RETAINED as engineering-cost debt attached to any future attempt to PRODUCTISE the resolved-pitch view
F4_compute_debt.explicit_guard: it must NOT drag the programme back into M85 optimisation now

F5_fresh_corpus.reasoning: every future confirmatory J-job needs fresh evidence, and this decision already records the 20-track BabySlakh evidence as consumed
F5_fresh_corpus.action_issued: MIR-CORPUS-01 - FRESH CORPUS AUTHORITY (data procurement and corpus governance, not a research experiment)

J3H_SCOPE_CORRECTION.retracted: J3H as the default successor lane
J3H_SCOPE_CORRECTION.why: source separation cannot fix a defect measured on an already isolated synth stem. The parked residual was measured on solo stems, where separation is a no-op by construction.
J3H_SCOPE_CORRECTION.J3H_remains_valid_as: Does high-quality source separation materially improve real-mixture source-conditioned harmonic observability?
J3H_SCOPE_CORRECTION.J3H_is_NOT: Can separation fix the parked synth/pad restraint residual?
J3H_SCOPE_CORRECTION.instruction: these two must never be conflated. J3H runs in parallel when matched real-audio material is available, with no claim whatsoever on the parked residual.

REVISED_SEQUENCE: 2. C3 experiential acceptance check (F3) - representative renders, product judgement
3. step upward into musical-state fusion: source-conditioned activity, orchestration change, harmonic root/chord state, tonal centre, arrangement transition
J3H runs in PARALLEL when its matched real-audio material is available

carried_forward_into_the_next_layer.higher_layer: decides what those facts mean together
